seriesBlurb: In these five cities the dead are never quite elsewhere: they pass their roles to actors who will not live to see the play end, lend their faces to strangers on a quay, set fashions from a buried twin, lie still in a city whose air has turned to earth, and wait with the unborn in the two bulbs of an hourglass that no one turns. Together the cities ask how much of every living place is on loan from those who came before and those still waiting to arrive.
